intro_desc_en: Foshan Jinyu Advertising Materials Co., Ltd. is a professional advertising materials manufacturer established in 2009. It is located in U + Zhigu Industrial Park, Lishui Town, Nanhai District, Foshan City, Guangdong Province - one of the most concentrated industrial gathering places for the production of advertising materials in China.
intro_desc_zh: 佛山市金昱广告材料有限公司是一家成立于2009年的专业广告材料制造商，位于广东省佛山市南海区里水镇U+智谷工业园——中国广告材料生产最集中的产业聚集地之一。
intro_desc_vi: Công ty TNHH Vật liệu Quảng cáo Phật Sơn Jinyu là một nhà sản xuất vật liệu quảng cáo chuyên nghiệp được thành lập vào năm 2009. Nó nằm ở Khu công nghiệp U + Zhigu, thị trấn Lishui, huyện Nam Hải, thành phố Phật Sơn, tỉnh Quảng Đông - một trong những nơi tập trung công nghiệp tập trung nhất để sản xuất vật liệu quảng cáo ở Trung Quốc.
intro_desc_ph: Foshan Jinyu Advertising Materyales Co., Ltd. ay isang propesyonal na advertising materyales tagagawa itinatag noong 2009. Ito ay matatagpuan sa U + Zhigu Industrial Park, Lishui Town, Nanhai District, Foshan City, Guangdong Province - isa sa mga pinaka - puro pang - industriya pagtitipon lugar para sa produksyon ng mga materyales sa advertising sa Tsina.
business_desc_en: Our business covers the design, research and development, production and sales of advertising materials, including self-adhesive vinyl film, PVC inkjet cloth, PVC foam board, acrylic board, aluminum-plastic board, PP hollow board, reflective materials, display shelves and logo manufacturing accessories.
business_desc_zh: 我们的业务涵盖广告材料的设计、研发、生产与销售，产品包括自粘乙烯基薄膜、PVC喷绘布、PVC发泡板、亚克力板、铝塑板、PP中空板、反光材料、展示架及标识制作配件。
business_desc_vi: Hoạt động kinh doanh của chúng tôi bao gồm thiết kế, nghiên cứu và phát triển, sản xuất và bán các vật liệu quảng cáo, bao gồm màng vinyl tự dính, vải in phun PVC, bảng xốp PVC, bảng acrylic, bảng nhựa nhôm, bảng rỗng PP, vật liệu phản chiếu, kệ trưng bày và phụ kiện sản xuất logo.
business_desc_ph: Ang aming negosyo ay sumasaklaw sa disenyo, pananaliksik at pag - unlad, produksyon at mga benta ng mga materyales sa advertising, kabilang ang self - malagkit vinyl film, PVC inkjet tela, PVC foam board, acrylic board, aluminum - plastic board, PP guwang board, mapanimdim materyales, display shelves at logo manufacturing accessories.
export_desc_en: Our products are exported to Southeast Asia, Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and major markets around the world, and are known for their durability, customizability, and factory direct supply prices.
export_desc_zh: 我们的产品出口至东南亚、欧洲、美洲、中东及全球各大市场，以耐用性强、可定制化、工厂直供价格极具竞争力著称。
export_desc_vi: Sản phẩm của chúng tôi được xuất khẩu sang Đông Nam Á, Châu Âu, Châu Mỹ, Trung Đông và các thị trường lớn trên thế giới, và được biết đến với độ bền, khả năng tùy biến và giá cung cấp trực tiếp tại nhà máy.
export_desc_ph: Ang aming mga produkto ay na - export sa Timog - silangang Asya, Europa, Amerika, Gitnang Silangan at mga pangunahing merkado sa buong mundo, at kilala para sa kanilang tibay, pagpapasadya, at factory direktang presyo ng supply.
mission_en: Reliable, high-quality materials for advertising practitioners and logo makers around the world, enabling exceptional ideas at competitive prices directly from the factory floor.
mission_zh: 为全球广告从业者和标识制作企业提供可靠、高品质的材料，以工厂直供的竞争性价格助力卓越创意的实现。
vision_en: Become a world-renowned manufacturer of advertising materials - known in the industry for product innovation, quality consistency and long-lasting customer relationships.
vision_zh: 成为全球知名的广告材料制造商——以产品创新、质量一致性和长期稳固的客户合作关系著称于业界。
values_en: Quality first, integrity management, continuous improvement, customer-centric. Every batch of products must meet the standards we set for ourselves, not just the qualification line.
values_zh: 质量第一、诚信经营、持续改进、以客户为中心。每一批产品都必须达到我们为自己设定的标准，而不仅仅是合格线。
factory_desc_en: Located in U+Zhigu Industrial Park, LiShui Town, Nanhai District – one of Foshan's premium industrial zones dedicated to advanced manufacturing.
factory_desc_zh: 工厂位于广东省佛山市南海区里水镇U+智谷工业园，这是佛山市先进制造领域的高端产业园区之一。

milestones.desc_en: Foshan Jin Yu Advertising Material Co., Ltd officially founded in Nanhai District, Foshan. Initial product range focused on PVC foam board and self adhesive vinyl for domestic market supply.
milestones.desc_zh: 佛山市金昱广告材料有限公司在佛山市南海区正式成立，初期产品聚焦PVC发泡板和自粘乙烯基薄膜，面向国内市场供货。

milestones.desc_en: Participated in the Canton Fair (China Import and Export Fair) for the first time. Successfully established partnerships with overseas buyers from Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.
milestones.desc_zh: 首次参加中国进出口商品交易会（广交会），成功与来自东南亚、中东和欧洲的海外买家建立合作关系。

milestones.desc_en: Dedicated research and development team formed to drive product innovation, custom formulation development, and technical support capabilities for international clients.
milestones.desc_zh: 专业研发团队正式组建，推动产品创新、定制配方开发，并为国际客户提供技术支持能力。

milestones.desc_en: Significant investment in new production lines and advanced equipment. Manufacturing capacity increased substantially to meet growing international order volumes across all product categories.
milestones.desc_zh: 大力投入新生产线和先进设备，制造产能大幅提升，以满足各品类产品不断增长的国际订单需求。

milestones.desc_en: Successfully completed ISO 9001:2015 quality management system certification. Full quality documentation, process controls, and continuous improvement systems formalized across all operations.
milestones.desc_zh: 成功完成ISO 9001:2015质量管理体系认证，全面建立质量文档、过程控制和持续改进体系，覆盖全部生产运营环节。

capacity_cards.desc_en: Advanced extrusion lines, calendering equipment, coating machines, and slitting systems expanded in 2023
capacity_cards.desc_zh: 先进的挤出生产线、压延设备、涂布机和分切系统，2023年扩大规模

capacity_cards.desc_en: In-house testing lab and R&D team for custom formulation, product development, and quality verification
capacity_cards.desc_zh: 内部测试实验室和研发团队，用于定制配方、产品开发和质量验证

capacity_cards.desc_en: Dedicated export packaging zone with moisture-proof and shock-resistant packing for international shipping
capacity_cards.desc_zh: 专用出口包装区，采用防潮、防震包装，确保国际运输安全

capacity_cards.desc_en: Raw material incoming inspection → in-process quality checks → final product testing → packaging verification → pre-shipment inspection available.
capacity_cards.desc_zh: 原材料进厂检验→过程质量检查→成品测试→包装验证→装运前检验。

capacity_cards.desc_en: FOB Guangzhou / Foshan. LCL and FCL available. We work with major freight forwarders and can assist with customs documentation, COO, and inspection certificates.
capacity_cards.desc_zh: FOB广州/佛山。可提供散货和整柜。我们与主要货代合作，可协助办理清关文件、产地证和检验证书。

capacity_cards.desc_en: Private label packaging, custom specifications, color matching, and dedicated production runs available for established importers and distributors.
capacity_cards.desc_zh: 可提供私人标签包装、定制规格、颜色调配和专属生产线，适用于成熟的进口商和分销商。

certifications.name: ISO 9001:2015
certifications.desc_en: Quality Management System certification. Achieved in 2024. Covers all manufacturing operations including vinyl, board products and accessories.
certifications.desc_zh: 质量管理体系认证，2024年获得，覆盖乙烯基薄膜、板材产品及配件等全部生产运营。

certifications.name: REACH / RoHS
certifications.desc_en: EU chemical and hazardous substance compliance for applicable product lines. Supporting documentation provided for EU import requirements.
certifications.desc_zh: 适用产品线的欧盟化学品及有害物质合规认证，可提供欧盟进口所需的完整支持文件。

certifications.name: Test Reports
certifications.desc_en: Third-party laboratory test reports for physical performance, weather resistance, fire rating and other product-specific certifications available per product line.
certifications.desc_zh: 可按产品线提供物理性能、耐候性、防火等级及其他产品专项认证的第三方实验室检测报告。

team_members.desc_en: International B2B sales, client relations and export documentation. Direct contact for all international enquiries.
team_members.desc_zh: 负责国际B2B销售、客户关系管理及出口文件处理，所有国际询盘的直接联系人。

team_members.desc_en: Product innovation, custom formulation, quality control, and technical documentation for international compliance requirements.
team_members.desc_zh: 负责产品创新、定制配方研发、质量控制，以及满足国际合规要求的技术文件编制。

team_members.desc_en: Experienced production workforce operating our expanded manufacturing facility with ISO 9001 quality procedures.
team_members.desc_zh: 经验丰富的生产团队按ISO 9001质量程序运营我们不断扩展的制造基地。

team_members.desc_en: 负责国际B2B销售、客户关系管理及出口文件处理
负责国际B2B销售、客户关系管理及出口文件处理
